summary: Corporación América Airports S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting April 2026 passenger traffic, which increased 2.6% year-over-year. The document is a routine operational update, not a special situation. No merger, acquisition, activist campaign, restructuring, or other transformative event is disclosed. The filing is a periodic report on traffic statistics, not a triggering event for any special-situations category.
